items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

ctx.x: So I had a little diamond ring that I had bought, because I was following my mentor see? Which was excellent advice. So I went to the music store and they had an old bass in the corner and I says, “well look man,” I said, “I’m working down here at Pep’s, and all I have is my ring, can I use your bass for a couple of days?” So he looked at the ring, he

says, “yeah, okay.” So he loaned me this bass, he asked me who was I working with. I told him Ella Fitzgerald, that type of thing, and so I took the bass and went down and worked with her a few days. Then in the meantime we sent for my other bass. And so it arrived, my Chubby Jackson model. And so I took it back. That’s how that happened, one week with Ella.
Yeah I bet the bass from the pawn shop didn’t have five strings on it.
